name: stateTime
meaning: g_gameTime at the last state change (respawn timers, the 3 s sheep-attraction delay)

name: eatenTime
meaning: sum of g_dt over msg 1 from sheep in state 0; >= 0x14000 (20 s) = eaten -> respawn. Zeroed only by Init/Reset/StartRespawn

name: homePos
meaning: ground-snapped placed position (ScnObject_QueryGroundY at Init); respawn point

name: state
meaning: BushState (0 idle, 1 respawn hidden, 2 respawn wobble, 3 worn by Ralph)

name: bushFlags
meaning: BushFlags: 1 fan-blown this frame, 2 lift lock (1 s), 4 Ralph within 50 last frame

name: liftLockMs
meaning: ms since MSG_LIFT_CRUSH; bushFlags bit 1 is cleared above 1000
